description_text: This is amendment 001 to the solicitation. It is showing as update 002 in PIEE solicitation module due to a technical error.The purpose of this contract is to assist the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Mobile District (both civil works and military) and its customers in the accomplishment of multi-disciplinary cultural resource services that occur in the Continental United States (CONUS) and Outside of the Continental United States (OCONUS). The contract period will be for 5 years, which includes a base year and 4 SATO that are (12-month period). The estimated POP date for this IDIQ is 05/1/2026-04/30/31 Please see attached Seed Project PWS for more details.03/09/2026 Uploaded Revised Bid Schedule to reflect cultural resources services
